_comment: Scope fence + build gate for graphs/sentiment_aggregator.json. Target repo: ~/code/stock_research_tools/sentiment_aggregator, a STANDALONE RUST 2021 CARGO CRATE (no C++/CMake). Each Module node is fenced to its own src/<module>/ directory; every node may also append its `pub mod` line to src/lib.rs and its dependency to Cargo.toml (shared_allow). The `app` node is the only one allowed to touch src/main.rs / src/lib.rs / Cargo.toml as its primary work and must not enter any src/<module>/ subdir. The gate is `cargo build --all-targets` then `cargo test`; a node is not marked implemented until both pass.

sentiment.note: The full VADER and Loughran-McDonald word lists are placed under src/sentiment/data/ by the `vader_lexicon` and `loughran_mcdonald` Artifact nodes; this module `include_str!`s them and must NOT hand-write or trim them. Only this module's own .rs code counts toward the line budget.

app.note: Integration root only. Never create or edit files under src/<module>/ — those belong to their own nodes.

_verify_comment: Runs in the target repo after every node. `cargo build --all-targets` compiles the lib, the bin and the tests; `cargo test` runs whatever unit tests the node added. Deliberately no `cargo clippy -D warnings` gate — a local 30B model fails pedantic lints on nearly every node and it is not worth the retry cost.
